official_title: A Phase II Study of an EGFR Exon 20 Insertion-Directed Therapy in Advanced NSCLC
conditions: Metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion

inclusion: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
Documented EGFR exon 20 insertion by a validated local or central molecular assay.
Measurable disease by RECIST-style radiographic assessment.
Adequate organ function, including creatinine clearance (CrCl) >= 50 mL/min calculated by CKD-EPI within the protocol-defined screening window.
exclusion: Prior therapy with an investigational EGFR exon 20 insertion-directed agent.
Untreated or unstable central nervous system metastases requiring escalating corticosteroids.
Clinically significant intercurrent illness that would interfere with protocol therapy or safety monitoring.

Ambiguous prior-platinum language: patients who received prior platinum-based chemotherapy, including carboplatin plus pemetrexed, may be excluded unless the investigator confirms eligibility under the current line-of-therapy amendment.

arms_interventions.description: Participants receive a synthetic EGFR exon 20 insertion-directed therapy on 28-day cycles until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal, or completion of protocol therapy.
